breakouts.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: N.Pullard
list.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] slides into the starting lineup with J.Joseph gone. Better yet, he jumped from 75 to 79 overall this offseason. And he saw his man coverage (83 to 87) and press coverage (71 to 75) take a big step in training. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: M.Goodman
list.d: [[p:557715432|M.Goodman]] is penciled in as a starter for the first time. On top of that, he saw his pass blocking (84 to 88) and power pass protection (88 to 92) take a big step in training. And he brings a agile skill set to a scheme that ranks 15th in total offensive yards per game. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: J.Blue
list.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] slides into the starting lineup with D.Sanchez gone. Also: he jumped from 73 to 76 overall this offseason. Plus, he saw his man coverage (78 to 82) and press coverage (67 to 71) take a big step in training. Circle his name now.

list.name: J.Coleman
list.d: [[p:557713612|J.Coleman]] slides into the starting lineup with R.Owens II gone. Add this: North Texas leans on the run game (5th in rushing yards per game last year). Plus, he ran for 5.5 yards a carry as a backup. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: L.Brown
list.d: [[p:557723896|L.Brown]] slides into the starting lineup with F.Brewu gone. Also: he piled up 4 sacks without starting. And he brings a pure power skill set to a scheme that ranks 5th in defensive rush yards per game. Circle his name now.
